dict.string: Quasar uses the camera only when you allow a website to access it.
Quasar uses the microphone while you dictate in Work, and for a website only when you allow it.
Quasar turns what you dictate in Work into text on this Mac.
Quasar saves the files you download to your Downloads folder.
Quasar saves downloads to your Desktop when you choose it as the download folder.
Quasar saves downloads to your Documents folder when you choose it as the download folder.
